calibration: Uncalibrated. Phase 1f measured mean predicted P(S) at 3.2x and P(F) at 14.5x the true class rates. Treat the scores as a ranking of beats, not as probabilities, until Phase 1f Stage B fits a correction.
dataset: St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database v1.0.0 (PhysioNet incartdb)
holds_up_rule: The DS2 headline macro-F1 falls inside INCART's 95% interval.
not_clinical: Research result on a public dataset; not clinical validation and not a medical device.

patient_grouping.note: Resampled by patient: 32 patients, from files-patients-diagnoses.txt.

position_check.amplitude_note: Median of the largest |band-passed| value within +/-50 ms of each mark, in mV. Diagnostic only; nothing is rescaled.

question: Does the MIT-BIH beat model work on new patients and equipment?

run.commit_note: The incart module was not yet committed at run time (PERMISSIONS.md: commits need the user's OK), so the working tree was dirty; this is the nearest commit, not a verified provenance record. The provenance block holds library versions and input hashes.
run.device: MacBook CPU (torch on CPU); caffeinate -i kept the Mac from idle sleep
run.not_in_this_file: Per-beat predictions stay in $SMART_HEALTH_DATA/processed/incartdb/predictions/; this file holds aggregates only.
run.scored_once: INCART was scored once. A 2-record smoke run before it printed beat counts and timing only, no metrics.
